validation.boundary: Identical resident frozen VP8L input. Independent owned RGBA8. Complete public managed Decode, output acquisition/disposal; native software webp decode, state reset, ARGB-to-RGBA conversion, owned output allocation/release. Native codec/conversion contexts and packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts every pixel. Padded native rows exposed without an extra packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation/encoding, hashing and validation excluded. Exact original RGBA, alpha and hidden RGB. One existing raster; no quality enumeration. Existing sixteen-color PNG projection and frozen native type3 color-index transform, two packed indices per coded green byte; complete inverse palette expansion and output packing timed. No extra original raster.
